message.reasoning_content: The pgrep matched its own wrapper shell command line (contains 'python3 service.py' in the command string). No actual python3 service process. Let me do a precise check with pgrep -x python3 and pgrep -f but exclude the bash wrapper. Use `pgrep -af 'python3 service\.py$'`? The cmdline is "python3 service.py" exactly. Let's check /proc scan.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "ps -eo pid,cmd | awk '$2 ~ /python3$/ && $3==\"service.py\" {print}' ; echo \"exit=$?\"\necho \"--- explicit ---\"\npgrep -ax python3 || echo \"no python3 processes at all\""}
